summary.ja: 単一参照が不足する系と活性空間の選び方を整理する。
summary.en: Map active spaces and systems beyond a single reference.

references.label: Roos, B. O.; Taylor, P. R.; Siegbahn, P. E. M. (1980), A complete active space SCF method (CASSCF) using a density matrix formulated super-CI approach
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Introductory formulation and comparison, not a verified executable solver.
Representative electronic-structure formulas use nonrelativistic Born–Oppenheimer theory unless the section explicitly states otherwise.
units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
boundary_conditions: Isolated or periodic conditions must be selected for each physical system; no numerical boundary-value example is published here yet.

next_deliverable.ja: 活性空間を明示した小規模比較。
next_deliverable.en: A small comparison with an explicit active space.

limitations.ja: 日英の導入・代表式・一次文献を公開。専用の実装・数値検証はUnder construction。活性空間依存を数値格子の誤差と混同しません。異なる核配置で活性軌道の性質が変わっていないかも追跡します。
limitations.en: Introductory bilingual reading, representative equations and primary references are available. No dedicated implementation or numerical verification result is provided yet. Active-space dependence is distinct from grid error. Track orbital character across geometries rather than only orbital indices.

metadata_review.level: curated introductory formulation with primary publication and official-documentation entry points; full derivation audit and numerical examples pending

assumptions_ja: 定式化と比較の導入解説であり、実行・検証済みソルバーではありません。
代表式は、各節に別記する場合を除き非相対論・Born–Oppenheimerの電子状態問題を想定します。
units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・周期を対象系ごとに選ぶ必要があります。この導入には実行済みの境界値計算例はまだありません。

caution.ja: 活性空間依存を数値格子の誤差と混同しません。異なる核配置で活性軌道の性質が変わっていないかも追跡します。
caution.en: Active-space dependence is distinct from grid error. Track orbital character across geometries rather than only orbital indices.
